title: Decode Telemetry Status Word
shortDescription: Extract health flags and small fields from a telemetry status word.

objectives: Extract health flags and small fields from a telemetry status word

hints.nudge: A flag and a multi-bit field need different masks.
hints.approach: Annotate the status word with each field’s starting bit and width. Test your extraction reasoning with a word that contains unrelated set bits.

templates.notes: Keep extraction explicit; avoid magic assumptions about byte order.

visibleCases.name: all clear
visibleCases.displayExpect:
out.ready = false
out.degraded = false
out.fault = false
out.subsystem = 0
out.error_code = 0
status_faulted(0) = false
visibleCases.explanation: Zero input should decode to default values.

visibleCases.name: extract fields
visibleCases.displayExpect:
out.ready = true
out.degraded = true
out.fault = false
out.subsystem = 9
out.error_code = 18

hiddenCases.name: error without fault
hiddenCases.displayInput: error code set but fault bit clear
hiddenCases.explanation: Do not infer fault from nonzero error code.

hiddenCases.name: ready and degraded
hiddenCases.displayInput: ready and degraded flags both set
